summary: Squire's session stays running and reachable whatever words Claude Code's Remote Control server prints: the runner judges a server live by evidence, never by its wording, and set-up opens the address where the Squire owner's first message starts the session, so setting Squire up works with the Claude Code that Claude's installer serves that day; an update's check needs a live server and a clean health check, never a session, an install waits while the Mac is still tearing down the background agents it reloads, and every failure names its reason; set-up keeps a Squire window in front naming what it is doing and how far it has got from the first click to the end; set-up takes the Apple silicon builds on Apple silicon even under Rosetta; and the health check says in one plain line when Claude Code is newer than this Squire release was tested with.
title: The session whatever Claude Code prints, a window always on screen through set-up, the Mac's own builds and the Claude Code a release was tested with
